theme: 基金·份额变动与规模排名：华安黄金ETF(518880)资金净流入/最新规模/同类商品型基金规模排名，话题切换至中欧医疗健康混合A单位净值

initial.question: 最近黄金ETF吸金很猛，帮我看看华安黄金ETF（518880）最近一周资金净流入大概有多少？
initial.gold_display: 最近5个交易日累计净流入约4.61亿元（截至2026-09-02）
initial.gold_sql: SELECT NET_INFLOW FROM ETF_SHARES_CHANGE_ROLL WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='518880.SH' AND ROLL_NUM=5 AND HISVALID=1 AND TRADING_DAY=(SELECT MAX(TRADING_DAY) FROM ETF_SHARES_CHANGE_ROLL WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='518880.SH' AND ROLL_NUM=5 AND HISVALID=1)

feedbacks.question: 它现在最新规模做到多大了？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT NET_VALUE FROM FUND_SHARES_CHANGE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='518880.SH' AND HISVALID=1 ORDER BY END_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 放到同类里比一下呢，商品型基金按最新规模排前五的都是哪几只？
feedbacks.gold_value: 华安黄金易(ETF)、博时黄金ETF、易方达黄金ETF、国泰黄金ETF、华夏黄金ETF
feedbacks.gold_display: 商品型基金最新规模前五：华安黄金易(ETF)约1043.48亿、博时黄金ETF约419.42亿、易方达黄金ETF约366.67亿、国泰黄金ETF约350.75亿、华夏黄金ETF约172.51亿（2026-09-02）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT s.FUND_NAME, f.NET_VALUE FROM MUTUAL_FUND_SECTOR s JOIN FUND_SHARES_CHANGE f ON s.FUND_SYMBOL=f.FUND_SYMBOL WHERE s.HISVALID=1 AND s.CUR_SIGN='1' AND s.SECTOR_NAME_1='基金投资范围板块' AND s.SECTOR_NAME_3='商品型基金' AND f.HISVALID=1 AND f.NET_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND f.END_DATE=(SELECT MAX(END_DATE) FROM FUND_SHARES_CHANGE WHERE HISVALID=1 AND NET_VALUE IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY s.FUND_SYMBOL, s.FUND_NAME, f.NET_VALUE ORDER BY f.NET_VALUE DESC LIMIT 5

feedbacks.question: 那上个季度整体来看呢，资金到底是净流入还是净流出？
feedbacks.gold_display: 净流出：2026年二季度合计净流出约126.99亿元
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(NET_INFLOW) FROM FUND_SHARES_CHANGE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='518880.SH' AND HISVALID=1 AND END_DATE>='2026-04-01' AND END_DATE<'2026-07-01'

feedbacks.question: 好，明白了。对了确认一下，这些日频的份额变动和净流入，都是按交易所每天披露的份额数据算出来的吧？
再帮我查个别的，中欧医疗健康混合A最新的单位净值是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT UNIT_NAV FROM FUND_NETVALUE WHERE FUND_SYMBOL='003095.OF' AND HISVALID=1 ORDER BY TRADING_DAY DESC LIMIT 1
